features.name: Site search
features.evidence: quicksearch component: input + button, results from the search page

i18n_notes: Three locale trees (en, de, fr) share one template; the scoped tree is /en/.

open_questions.question: Is metadata-based search (query index) acceptable, or is full-text search required?
open_questions.context: EDS indexes give titles, descriptions and metadata.
open_questions.default: Query-index search with title-first ranking, checked against the recorded probe counts.

open_questions.question: Which locale trees follow the scoped tree, in what order?
open_questions.default: Scoped tree first; the code base is built locale-ready; trees follow by traffic.
